result: Shampoo preconditions a matrix (or tensor) gradient from each side: W ← W − η L^{-1/4} G R^{-1/4} with L = Σ GGᵀ, R = Σ GᵀG. The Kronecker product of the two small factors dominates full-matrix AdaGrad's preconditioner (Lemma 8), giving O(√T) regret with m² + n² memory instead of (mn)².
result_plain: Left/right Kronecker-factored preconditioner L^{-1/4} G R^{-1/4}; O(√T) regret, m² + n² memory.
